page.overview:
Who is Aerie?

As the word "aerie" or "eyrie" refers to the nest of a bird of prey, it has also been used as the name for home bases of several bird-themed heroes like Lady Blackhawk and Hawkman.

Aerie was created by Tom Taylor and Bruno Redondo, first appearing in (2020).
